title: WPMS/3266/2017 of M/s Vrahmurti Flexi Rub India Pvt Ltd Vs Additional Labour Commission And Prescribed Officer Haridwar AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
WPMS NO. 3266 of 2017
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Navneet Kaushik, Advocate for
the petitioner.
By means of this petition,
petitioner has sought following relief:
ìIssue appropriate order or direction
setting aside the impugned order dated
12.09.2017 passed by respondent no.1 in P.W.A.
No. 63 of 2015 titile Smt. Sushma Devi Vs. M/s
Vrahmurti Flexi Rub India Pvt. Ltd. and to allow
the recall application dated 26.08.2017 and to
direct the respondent no.1 hear the case on
meritsî
Heard.
Issue notice to respondents by
registered post, acknowledgement due,
returnable at an early date. In addition
to normal mode of service petitioner is
permitted to serve respondents by
Dasti.
Steps to be taken within 5 days.
List this petition on 14.02.2018.
In the meantime, it is provided
that if petitioner deposits a sum of Rs.
30,000/- on or before 04.01.2018 with
the Additional Labour Commissioner
Haridwar/Prescribed Officer, Payment
of Wages Act 1936 Haridwar, no
coercive action shall be taken against
the petitioner pursuant to the
impugned recovery citation.
 Consequently, interim relief
application (CLMA No. 16836 of 2017)
stands disposed of.
(Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
 22.12.2017
Mamta
